name: Sol'amati
source:
An adult light-red om'veri with a liquid crimson mane and white horns that together form a trident on the back of its head. Its head shape resembles a shark's. White armored scales run along the middle of its snout. Pale plates are present on the upper part of its tail. The wing membranes and belly are grey.
Sol'amati is not under the influence of Chime-Kalantre's patriarchal culture. Sol'amati cares for his sister, Silitreya, often spoiling her. From time to time, he enters into verbal conflicts with his father regarding his sister's future. He has always shared what he had with Silitreya.
